hypothesis: The five corpus-annotated conjoint-leaf pairs show greater lexical coherence than alternative perfect matchings, including cross-half alternatives, without selecting an inter-bifolium order.
mapping_verification: Corpus metadata Q=M, B=1..5 and H=2,L=B on both sides; B values verify each pair. Author Lisa Fagin Davis directly identifies 75|84 and 78|81 at https://www.voynich.ninja/thread-5186.html. Full paper primary table is inaccessible behind OpenEdition's Anubis challenge; this test does not use its hypothetical inter-bifolium order.

lexical.parser: Literal lowercase EVA paragraph chunks; annotations, drawing breaks and invalid chunks are discarded as separators. Comma=boundary primary; comma=join sensitivity. Aggregate recto+verso per physical leaf.
lexical.primary: Mean TF-IDF token cosine over the five paired leaves, with IDF fitted on physical leaves outside Q13 only; OOV tokens omitted, coverage reported.
nulls: All 945 perfect matchings of the same ten leaves, including observed
All 120 one-to-one matchings between 75..79 and 80..84, including observed
lexical.tail: Exact inclusive upper tail, tolerance 1e-12; score each pre-fixed matching once; ranks are conditional random-matching reference ranks, not evidence for historical randomized binding.
robustness: Same fixed representations on recto-only and verso-only views; both observed-minus-null-mean must be positive.

Residual lexical coherence after fixed OLS over all 45 possible edges with intercept,char3 cosine,absolute log token-count ratio,and squared folio-number gap/100; no physical-pair labels used to fit nuisance coefficients.
Repeat primary and residual metrics with comma=join. Both parser modes must satisfy gates.
Leave one observed pair out; all five remaining eight-leaf subsets must have positive observed-minus-null-mean in both parser modes; these are overlapping diagnostics, not five independent tests.
Character trigram and character Jensen-Shannon similarities are secondary diagnostics; no choosing whichever metric passes.

timesfm.role: Secondary structural diagnostic; cannot rescue lexical primary failure.
timesfm.parser_features: Exactly feature_rows and ten features from timesfm_singulion_q13.py
timesfm.scales: Variance of feature rows outside Q13 only.
timesfm.prediction: Generate one forecast per source page before inspecting any matching score; save contexts, targets, predictions and per-feature directed-page losses.
timesfm.pair_cost: Symmetric mean over all eight directed cross-leaf page comparisons (r/r,r/v,v/r,v/v in both directions). No within-leaf transition enters statistic.
metrics: Same model loss excluding token count feature
timesfm.nulls: Same 945 and 120 exact matchings; inclusive lower tail.

decision.candidate: PASS_STRUCTURAL_CANDIDATE only if both comma modes: primary p945<=.05 and p120<=.05; residual p945<=.05 and p120<=.05; positive recto/verso deviations from both null means; positive deviations in all five leave-pair-out subsets. Otherwise FAIL_STRICT_PAIR_COHERENCE. Missing/hash/metadata failures -> BLOCKED.
decision.semantic: NOT_RUN. No word translations, language identification, validation of a unique reading order, or claim of novelty.
decision.scope: Follow-up on already inspected Q13. No untouched manuscript holdout or independent transcription; a positive result would require independent-quire/transcription replication before any general claim.
decision.multiplicity: One predeclared lexical primary; all gates are an intersection, secondary metrics are descriptive and may not replace the primary.

reporting: Save full edge matrices, all matching scores, parser/coverage/metadata audit, diagnostics, source and code hashes, meaningful harness checks, CI audit with measured comparison scope. Do not retune after actual results.
